post.meaning: Confucius said: The noble person has nine things in mind: to see clearly, to listen closely, to keep a gentle expression, to be respectful in manner, to be sincere in speech, to be careful in work, to ask when in doubt, to think of the consequences when angry, and to think of what is right when he sees a chance of gain.
post.caption:
孔子曰：“君子有九思：视思明，听思聪，色思温，貌思恭，言思忠，事思敬，疑思问，忿思难，见得思义。”

कन्फ़्यूशियस ने कहा: श्रेष्ठ व्यक्ति नौ बातों का ध्यान रखता है: देखे तो साफ़ देखे, सुने तो ध्यान से सुने, चेहरा सौम्य रखे, व्यवहार विनम्र रखे, बोले तो सच्चा बोले, काम करे तो लगन से करे, संदेह हो तो पूछे, क्रोध आए तो परिणाम सोचे, और लाभ दिखे तो सोचे कि वह उचित है या नहीं।

Confucius said: The noble person has nine things in mind: to see clearly, to listen closely, to keep a gentle expression, to be respectful in manner, to be sincere in speech, to be careful in work, to ask when in doubt, to think of the consequences when angry, and to think of what is right when he sees a chance of gain.

— Confucius, Analects, 16.10

reel.meaning: He said: 'And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, except those who have lost their way?'
reel.caption:
قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

उसने कहा: अपने रब की रहमत से गुमराहों के सिवा और कौन मायूस होता है?

He said: 'And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, except those who have lost their way?'

— Quran, Al-Hijr 15:56
